plot.caption: paced most like their own race

method: Each start-screened edition with at least 500 finishes, in races with three or more such editions (173 editions, 20 races, 3,777,177 finishes): the median of each 5K section's pace relative to the finish's own 5–20K pace, 5–10K to 35–40K; the nearest other edition by Euclidean distance over those seven values, against the share a random other edition would give. "The race" covers its course, field and weather together, and is grouped by race name. In 10 of the 20 races, half or more of the editions are nearest to the same race.
